config.displays.cab_mode.description: Presents VPinFE for playing standing at a cabinet: larger text and targets, and no controls that need a mouse. It does not rotate anything.
config.displays.cab_mode.label: Cabinet Mode
config.dof.dof_config_tool_api_key.label: DOF Config Tool API Key
config.dof.enable_dof.label: Enable DOF
config.frontend.confirm.description: Ask before quitting VPinFE or powering off the machine. Closing the frontend never asks - the windows reopen from the Manager UI, so there is nothing to lose. Off is how VPinFE has always behaved, and the question is put to whichever surface asked.
config.frontend.confirm.label: Confirm Before Exit
config.frontend.hide_quit_button.label: Hide Quit from the Main Menu
config.frontend.paging_group.label: Page by
config.frontend.paging_size.label: Paging Size
config.frontend.restore_last_table.label: Restore Last Table
config.general.ask_where_new_games_go.de: On, an import that could go to more than one place asks which. Off, it goes to the one marked for new games without asking. Never asked where there is only one place it could go.
config.general.ask_where_new_games_go.la: Ask Where a New Game Goes
config.general.assets_dir.description: Root folder for assets shared across games rather than owned by one, such as manufacturer logos. Served at /assets/ and defaults to assets/ under the VPinFE config dir.
config.general.assets_dir.label: Shared Assets Directory
config.general.chrome_options.label: Additional Chrome Options
config.general.chrome_options_exclude.de: Which of the built-in options to leave off, one per line. For the case where one of them is the problem and turning all of them off would take the rest with it.
config.general.command_timeout.descripti: Seconds before a command is given up on. One that never finishes would mean no table launches again.
config.general.command_timeout.label: Give Each Command
config.general.game_root_dir.description: The folder holding your table folders, one folder per game.
config.general.game_root_dir.label: Tables Directory
config.general.hidden_asset_kinds.descri: Kinds of supporting file this library does not collect - an all-EM library has no ROMs. A table that will not launch still says so.
config.general.hidden_asset_kinds.label: Asset kinds to hide
config.general.hidden_media_kinds.descri: Kinds of artwork this library does not collect. VPinFE stops showing and counting them; the files stay where they are.
config.general.hidden_media_kinds.label: Media kinds to hide
config.general.language.description: What language VPinFE speaks. Auto follows the operating system. Table names and everything else your library holds are never translated.
config.general.language.label: Language
config.general.library_refresh_minutes.d: How often to re-read the library from disk, in minutes. It picks up everything, not just tables - media and assets added or removed beside them too. Zero never does, which is the default because a read walks every game folder: fine locally, real traffic on a network share. It can always be asked to read it now.
config.general.media_browse_dirs.descrip: Extra folders you can pick artwork from when adding media by hand. The game library is always available; anywhere else has to be listed here before VPinFE will read it.
config.general.media_browse_dirs.label: Browsable Media Folders
config.general.mute_audio.label: Mute Frontend Audio
config.general.on_table_exit.description: Run after every table. They run whenever the ones above ran, even if the table never started.
config.general.on_table_exit.label: When Any Table Exits
config.general.on_table_start.descriptio: Run before every table, whichever launcher plays it, and before that launcher's own commands.
config.general.on_table_start.label: When Any Table Starts
config.general.on_vpinfe_exit.descriptio: Run last. These run even if VPinFE is stopping because something went wrong.
config.general.on_vpinfe_exit.label: When VPinFE Exits
config.general.on_vpinfe_start.descripti: One command per line, run before anything else. Written the way a shell splits arguments, but nothing else a shell does - for a pipe, point at a script.
config.general.on_vpinfe_start.label: When VPinFE Starts
config.general.rar_tool_path.description: Path to unar or unrar. Blank auto-detects one on this machine.
config.general.rar_tool_path.label: RAR Tool Path
config.general.splashscreen.label: Enable Splash Screen
config.general.startup_collection.label: Default Startup Collection
config.general.table_start_required.desc: On, a command that fails before a table starts stops it launching - for something the table cannot do without, like a share to mount. Off, the failure is noted and the table starts anyway.
config.general.theme.label: Active Theme
config.install.display_name.description: What to call this device where one is listed. Defaults to this machine's hostname. Nothing is addressed by it, so renaming is safe.
config.install.display_name.label: Device Name
config.install.features.description: What this install is for: curating the game library (library), launching games on this machine (frontend), managing the other installs on your network (devices), and a rollup of all three (overview). Each one it has decides what the Console shows. Overview is the one that has to be asked for. Left empty the install is for nothing yet, and System is still there to configure it with.
config.install.features.label: Features
config.install.id.description: Written by VPinFE on first start, and not meant to be edited. Installs are told apart by this, so changing it makes this a different install.
config.libdmdutil.enabled.label: Enable libdmdutil
config.libdmdutil.pin2dmd_enabled.label: Enable PIN2DMD
config.logger.level.label: Log Verbosity
config.logger.terminal.label: Log to Terminal
config.media.asset_sources.description: Which online catalogs are searched for artwork. Empty means all of them. Names come from the sources list this install reports.
config.media.asset_sources.label: Online Artwork Sources
config.media.thumb_cache_max_mb.label: Thumbnail Cache Max (MB)
config.media.wheelset.description: Name of the wheel art set to use library-wide, a folder under a game's medias/wheels/. The reserved name logo shows each game's logo instead. Blank means plain wheels, and the active theme can override this with its own wheelSet option.
config.media.wheelset.label: Wheel Set
config.mobile.chunk_size.label: Mobile Chunk Size
config.mobile.device_ip.label: Mobile Device IP
config.mobile.device_port.label: Mobile Device Port
config.mobile.rename_mask_to_default_ini: Where a table has no configuration file of its own, send the masked one in its place under the name the table expects.
The word between the table name and .ini - cab sends tablename.cab.ini as tablename.ini.
config.network.http_bind.description: Which address to serve on. The default answers every interface, which is what it has always done - set 127.0.0.1 to reach it only from this machine.
config.network.http_bind.label: HTTP Address
config.network.http_port.description: Port this install answers on: the HTTP API, the Console, the Manager UI, and the remote and mobile pages. Named for the protocol rather than any one thing listening on it.
config.network.http_port.label: HTTP Port
config.network.library_url.description: Which install this one reads its library from, for example http://cabinet.local:8001. Empty - the default - means this install holds its own, which is every single-machine setup. Installs on your network are offered; type an address for one that is not.
config.network.library_url.label: Library
config.network.theme_assets_bind.descrip: Which address to serve theme packages and table media on. The default answers this machine only. An address rather than a switch, so a single interface can be named; 0.0.0.0 is every one. This port serves the table library, so opening it shares read access to it.
config.network.theme_assets_bind.label: Theme Server Address
config.network.theme_assets_port.label: Theme Server Port
config.network.verify_shared_library.des: On startup, check that the library this install reads really is the one on disk here, by comparing file hashes rather than paths. Reports what does not match and changes nothing else. Off by default, and ignored entirely without a Library set.
config.network.ws_port.description: Port the frontend windows and the theme talk to VPinFE over. Loopback only.
config.network.ws_port.label: WebSocket Bridge Port
config.themes.registries.description: Catalogs to offer themes from, most trusted first. The stock registry is an entry like any other, so a mirrored or offline install can replace or drop it.
config.themes.registries.label: Theme Registries
config.themes.repositories.description: Individual theme repos, each one a theme in its own right. Resolved before the registries, and named for the repo with any vpinfe-theme- prefix removed.
config.themes.repositories.label: Theme Repositories
config.vpinplay.api_endpoint.label: API Endpoint
config.vpinplay.initials.label: Initials
config.vpinplay.machine_id.label: Machine ID
config.vpinplay.sync_on_exit.label: Sync on Exit
config.vpinplay.user_id.label: User ID
config.vpsdb.refresh.description: How often to ask VPSdb whether it has changed.
config.vpsdb.refresh.label: Check for Catalog Updates
config.windows.backglass.screen_id.label: Backglass Monitor ID
config.windows.backglass.window_override: Position and size for this window, as x,y,width,height. Empty means no override.
How far to turn playfield artwork so it fills the screen. auto measures each image and turns only when it disagrees with the surface.
config.windows.playfield.orientation.des: How the playfield screen is physically mounted. Portrait means it is turned on its side in the cabinet. This does not rotate anything by itself - it tells themes what shape to lay out for.
config.windows.playfield.rotation.descri: How far VPinFE turns its own display so it faces the player. Leave at 0 if your operating system already rotates this screen.
config.windows.playfield.rotation.label: Rotate VPinFE Display
config.windows.playfield.screen_id.label: Playfield Monitor ID
config.windows.playfield.variant.descrip: Which playfield artwork this library holds: table.png, or fss.png for art captured in Visual Pinball's Full Single Screen mode.
config.windows.playfield.variant.label: Table Type
config.windows.scoreview.screen_id.label: DMD Monitor ID
config.windows.scoreview.window_override: Position and size for this window, as x,y,width,height. Empty means no override.
